description: AgileSec FIPS Module is a component of AgileSec SDK. It provides secure and optimized implementations of FIPS 140-2 approved cryptographic algorithms. The design of AgileSec SDK uses plug-and-play cryptographic providers, which are sets of cryptographic algorithms implemented to support various international or custom cryptographic standards.
